# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the binaries' help; do not edit. -->

`dviscope` runs on collector hosts and CI; `dviscope-server` runs the server and its
administration. Exit codes: [errors.md](errors.md); operations: [operate.md](operate.md).

## `dviscope`

```text
DVIScope command-line client

Usage: dviscope [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  run              Run a command supervised and journal the attempt (spool for delivery)
  journal          The delivery journal
  spool            Delivery of journalled records
  checklist        Feature checklists
  hierarchy        The project hierarchy of the health dashboard (SoC, subsystems, blocks)
  source           Source identity of a candidate
  source-manifest  Journal a source manifest (repositories and revisions of a regression)
  regression       Journal regression operations
  manifest         Journal manifest operations of a regression
  tls              Local TLS certificates for a single-machine install
  doctor           Check configuration and, with --server, the server
  verdict          Evaluate merge readiness on the server; write the summary, then exit 0 (pass), 10 (fail), 11 (insufficient evidence), 2 usage, 3 rejected, 4 unreachable, 5 internal
  collect          Journal a run that already ended (executed by other means): extract its log and spool the attempt (output `state: spooled`; deliver with `spool flush`)
  extract          Extract evidence from a log (local; prints the evidence JSON)
  rules            Pattern packs: validation, debugging and activation
  sample           The project's activation sample
  ledger           Decisions ledger: export and import (owners, notes, bug URLs, exceptions)
  import           Import results collected elsewhere
  corpus           Private sample corpus
  help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>  Server URL (https:// only)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>        Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>    Private state directory
  -h, --help                     Print help
  -V, --version                  Print version
```

### `dviscope run`

```text
Run a command supervised and journal the attempt (spool for delivery)

Usage: dviscope run [OPTIONS] --journal <JOURNAL> --launch <LAUNCH> <CMD>...

Arguments:
  <CMD>...  The command and its arguments

Options:
      --journal <JOURNAL>           Journal directory
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>     Server URL (https:// only)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>           Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --launch <LAUNCH>             Launch specification (JSON: producer, regression, slot, attempt, execution)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>       Private state directory
      --timeout <TIMEOUT>           Timeout, seconds
      --grace <GRACE>               Grace period after the polite stop, seconds [default: 10]
      --console <CONSOLE>           Capture the command's stdout and stderr in this file
      --log <LOG>                   The log to extract after the run
      --subject <SUBJECT>           Evidence subject: simulation or build [default: simulation]
      --simulator <SIMULATOR>       Simulator the run declares (questa, vcs, verilator); default: detected
      --pack <PACKS>                Extra pack: a YAML file or builtin:NAME (repeatable)
      --no-default-packs            Do not load the shipped packs
      --source-root <SOURCE_ROOTS>  Path prefix that makes source anchors repository-relative (repeatable)
  -h, --help                        Print help
```

### `dviscope journal`

```text
The delivery journal

Usage: dviscope journal [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init       Create a journal
  recover    Recover interrupted attempts (termination `unknown`; never relaunches)
  close      Close launches and print the watermark
  finish     Finish the regression once every participating journal has closed its launches and their starts are committed (the finish barrier)
  status     Entries and their delivery state
  reconcile  Compare the journal (and its registered participants) with the server: records committed but missing or different there, records never delivered, and started or reported slots the server does not count. Changes nothing; exit 0 when they agree, 10 when they do not
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>  Server URL (https:// only)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>        Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>    Private state directory
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

#### `dviscope journal init`

```text
Create a journal

Usage: dviscope journal init [OPTIONS] --dir <DIR> --id <ID>

Options:
      --dir <DIR>                  Journal directory
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>    Server URL (https:// only)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>          Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --id <ID>                    Journal ID
      --coordinator <COORDINATOR>  Coordinator journal of the regression to join (registered before this journal exists, so the finish barrier covers it)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>      Private state directory
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

```text
Delivery of journalled records

Usage: dviscope spool [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:

  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
```

#### `dviscope spool flush`

```text
Deliver pending entries

Usage: dviscope spool flush [OPTIONS] --dir <DIR>

Options:
      --dir <DIR>                Journal directory
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>  Server URL (https:// only)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>        Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --endpoint <ENDPOINT>      Receipt endpoint: `server` (the configured server URL, CA file and token file), or `dir:PATH` (the directory-backed test endpoint) [default: server]
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>    Private state directory
      --wait <WAIT>              `committed`: retry until every record is committed (or rejected), up to --deadline; exit 4 if some are still pending then
      --deadline <DEADLINE>      How long --wait retries (90s, 10m, 1h) [default: 10m]
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

### `dviscope doctor`

```text
Check configuration and, with --server, the server

Usage: dviscope doctor [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --server                   Also reach the server
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>  Server URL (https:// only)
      --assurance <PROJECT>      Print each producer's integration assurance profile for this project (what its data supports: counting, build provenance, merge gating; project admins)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>        Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --pilot                    Pilot checks: state location and privacy, token file, runner prerequisites, simulators on PATH and (with --server) CA trust and the clock offset
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>    Private state directory
      --reconcile <JOURNAL_DIR>  Reconcile these journals with the server (repeatable; as `journal reconcile`)
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

### `dviscope verdict`

```text
Evaluate merge readiness on the server; write the summary, then exit 0 (pass), 10 (fail), 11 (insufficient evidence), 2 usage, 3 rejected, 4 unreachable, 5 internal

Usage: dviscope verdict [OPTIONS] --project <PROJECT>

Options:
      --project <PROJECT>
          Project
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>
          Server URL (https:// only)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>
          Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --regression <REGRESSION>
          Regression reference (merge mode)
      --mode <MODE>
          `merge` (a regression for a candidate) or `feature` (a checklist for a branch) [default: merge]
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Private state directory
      --checklist <CHECKLIST>
          Checklist ID (feature mode)
      --checklist-version <CHECKLIST_VERSION>
          Checklist version (feature mode; default: the latest)
      --branch <BRANCH>
          Repository-qualified branch, `repo/name` (feature mode)
      --expect-source <EXPECT_SOURCE>
          The candidate's source digest (`dviscope source digest`)
      --summary <SUMMARY>
          `log-free` (default, safe to publish), `markdown` (the log-free summary for a CI comment, every value escaped) or `json` [default: log-free]
      --summary-file <SUMMARY_FILE>
          File receiving the summary (written before exiting, also on errors)
      --exceptions-fail
          Treat accepted_with_exceptions as failing (suite policy says otherwise)
      --wait-processed
          Wait while the verdict can still change by waiting (the collection is open, attempts are running, the server is unreachable), up to --deadline
      --deadline <DEADLINE>
          How long --wait-processed waits (90s, 15m, 2h) [default: 15m]
      --publish-receipt
          Store a publication receipt of the evaluation for this commit-status target (needs --target-repository, --target-commit, --target-context; triage rights)
      --target-repository <TARGET_REPOSITORY>
          Status target: `owner/name`
      --target-commit <TARGET_COMMIT>
          Status target: full commit SHA
      --target-context <TARGET_CONTEXT>
          Status target: context [default: dviscope/merge]
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

### `dviscope collect`

```text
Journal a run that already ended (executed by other means): extract its log and spool the attempt (output `state: spooled`; deliver with `spool flush`)

Usage: dviscope collect [OPTIONS] --journal <JOURNAL> --launch <LAUNCH> --started-at <STARTED_AT>

Options:
      --journal <JOURNAL>           Journal directory
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>     Server URL (https:// only)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>           Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --launch <LAUNCH>             The launch specification (as for `run`)
      --log <LOG>                   The run's log (none: evidence of a missing log)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>       Private state directory
      --exit-code <EXIT_CODE>       The run's exit code (none: the termination is unknown, never a pass)
      --started-at <STARTED_AT>     Start (RFC 3339)
      --finished-at <FINISHED_AT>   End (RFC 3339)
      --subject <SUBJECT>           Evidence subject: simulation or build [default: simulation]
      --simulator <SIMULATOR>       Simulator the run declares (questa, vcs, verilator); default: detected
      --pack <PACKS>                Extra pack: a YAML file or builtin:NAME (repeatable)
      --no-default-packs            Do not load the shipped packs
      --source-root <SOURCE_ROOTS>  Path prefix that makes source anchors repository-relative (repeatable)
  -h, --help                        Print help
```

```text
      --source-root <SOURCE_ROOTS>  Path prefix that makes source anchors repository-relative (repeatable)
      --log <LOG>                   Log file (for a Verilator model with its own main: its program log)
      --console <CONSOLE>           A Verilator model with its own main: its console capture, joined after the program log as the collector joins them (the line is then a joined line)
      --line <LINE>                 1-based line number
  -h, --help                        Print help
```

#### `dviscope import folder`

```text
A folder of logs and a CSV of the regression's expected jobs (columns: slot, test, seed, log, exit_code[, started_at, finished_at, required]); a preview unless --submit

Usage: dviscope import folder [OPTIONS] --root <ROOT> --manifest <MANIFEST> --regression <REGRESSION> --producer <PRODUCER> --repository <REPOSITORY> --branch <BRANCH> --revision <REVISION>

Options:
      --root <ROOT>                 The folder the CSV's log paths are relative to (a local path)
      --server-url <SERVER_URL>     Server URL (https:// only)
      --ca-file <CA_FILE>           Extra CA certificate to trust (PEM)
      --manifest <MANIFEST>         The CSV of expected jobs (one row per job; an empty log = did not report)
      --regression <REGRESSION>     Regression reference
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>       Private state directory
      --producer <PRODUCER>         Producer (the collector token's)
      --repository <REPOSITORY>     Repository of the branch and the sources
      --branch <BRANCH>             Branch name
      --revision <REVISION>         Source revision
      --suite <SUITE>               Suite [default: nightly]
      --started-at <STARTED_AT>     Regression start (RFC 3339); default: the earliest started_at
      --journal <JOURNAL>           Private journal directory (required with --submit; reusing it resumes)
      --submit                      Journal and deliver (otherwise only the preview)
      --subject <SUBJECT>           Evidence subject: simulation or build [default: simulation]
      --simulator <SIMULATOR>       Simulator the run declares (questa, vcs, verilator); default: detected
      --pack <PACKS>                Extra pack: a YAML file or builtin:NAME (repeatable)
      --no-default-packs            Do not load the shipped packs
      --source-root <SOURCE_ROOTS>  Path prefix that makes source anchors repository-relative (repeatable)
  -h, --help                        Print help
```

## `dviscope-server`

```text
DVIScope server

Usage: dviscope-server [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  run             Run the server (default)
  check           Validate the configuration and TLS files, then exit
  migrate         Apply pending database migrations (exclusive advisory lock), then exit
  retention       Apply retention: expire payloads, then facts, then receipts
  admin           Provisioning (audited)
  backup          Write a backup: a private pg_dump archive and its manifest of conservation values
  restore         Restore an archive into the configured database; maintenance on, sessions deleted, tokens disabled until re-enabled or rotated
  restore-verify  Compare the restored database with the archive's manifest (counts, readiness)
  demo            Create the "bad nightly" demo project (invented records: a repeated failure, an expired exception, a missing result, a failed build). Refuses an existing project
  maintenance     Maintenance mode: writes refused
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>  Configuration file (TOML) [env: DVISCOPE_SERVER_CONFIG=] [default: dviscope-server.toml]
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
```

### `dviscope-server run`

```text
Run the server (default)

Usage: dviscope-server run

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

```text
Validate the configuration and TLS files, then exit

Usage: dviscope-server check

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

```text
Apply pending database migrations (exclusive advisory lock), then exit

Usage: dviscope-server migrate

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

### `dviscope-server retention`

```text
Apply retention: expire payloads, then facts, then receipts

Usage: dviscope-server retention [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --dry-run        Report what would be removed (each regression), change nothing [alias: --preview]
      --now <NOW>      The clock (RFC 3339; default: now). For tests and previews
      --every <HOURS>  Keep running: apply retention every N hours (the compose `retention` service uses 24). Skipped, not failed, while the server is in maintenance
  -h, --help           Print help
```

### `dviscope-server admin`

```text
Provisioning (audited)

Usage: dviscope-server admin <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create-project        Create a project
  create-producer       Create a producer namespace in a project
  issue-token           Issue a collector token, written to a new owner-only file (never printed)
  issue-personal-token  Issue a personal token for a user, written to a new owner-only file (never printed; acts with the user's roles)
  reenable-token        Re-enable a token a restore disabled (after checking it was not leaked)
  revoke-token          Revoke a token
  quarantine-token      Quarantine a token from a receipt time on (and revoke it)
  release-token         Release a token's quarantine (it stays revoked)
  accept-pipeline       Accept a pipeline digest for a project
  withdraw-pipeline     Withdraw an accepted pipeline (its results stop settling)
  create-user           Create a local user; the password is read from a file or standard input
  set-member            Set a user's role in a project (viewer, triager, admin)
  help                  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

```text
Create a project

Usage: dviscope-server admin create-project [OPTIONS] --name <NAME>

Options:
      --name <NAME>      Project name (lower-case letters, digits, '-', '_')
      --policy <POLICY>  Retry policy: strict or retry-pass-accepted [default: strict]
  -h, --help             Print help
```
